workload.name: Docker: PostHog image
workload.description: docker buildx build of PostHog's production Dockerfile from a pinned commit, with no build cache: frontend and plugin-server builds, Python dependencies, and layer assembly. The source is fetched first, shallow (depth 1, no tags), in its own timed 'fetch source' phase, and the build uses that local checkout as its context.
workload.source: shallow fetch (depth 1, no tags) in the 'fetch source' phase; local build context

runners.label: runs-on={run_id},family=r8a.xlarge,image=ubuntu26-full-x64,ssh=false,retry=false,env=demo,extras=tmpfs
runners.note: Same AMD Turin CPU as runson-m8a-x64 with twice the RAM; /tmp, /home/runner and /var/lib/docker live in memory (extras=tmpfs).

suiteNotes.docker: With tmpfs, /var/lib/docker lives in RAM: a PostHog image build outgrows the 32 GB this machine shares between the tmpfs and the build itself, and the runner runs out of memory. r8a.2xlarge (64 GB) has the room.

runners.label: runs-on={run_id},family=m9g.xlarge,image=ubuntu26-full-arm64,ssh=false,retry=false,env=demo,extras=tmpfs
runners.note: Graviton on m9g.xlarge with /tmp, /home/runner and /var/lib/docker in memory (extras=tmpfs): the arm64 counterpart of the x64 tmpfs runners.

suiteNotes.docker: With tmpfs, /var/lib/docker lives in RAM: a PostHog image build outgrows the 16 GB this machine shares between the tmpfs and the build itself, and the runner goes down mid-build.

runners.label: runs-on={run_id},family=m9g.2xlarge,image=ubuntu26-full-arm64,ssh=false,retry=false,env=demo,extras=tmpfs
runners.note: Graviton on m9g.2xlarge with /tmp, /home/runner and /var/lib/docker in memory (extras=tmpfs): the arm64 counterpart of the x64 tmpfs runners.

suiteNotes.docker: With tmpfs, /var/lib/docker lives in RAM: a PostHog image build outgrows the 32 GB this machine shares between the tmpfs and the build itself, and the runner loses contact mid-build (out of memory).
